annotations.title: Dutch health insurance: yearly cost after the deductible and healthcare allowance

description: The yearly cost of basic health insurance in the Netherlands in 2026: premium (with the discount for a voluntary extra deductible), the deductible (eigen risico) actually paid for expected care costs, and the healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) for the income.

allowance_partner.description: Has an allowance partner. Default false.

annual_income.description: Yearly income for the healthcare allowance, euros

expected_care_costs.description: Expected care costs a year that fall under the deductible, euros. Default 0.

monthly_premium.description: Basic insurance premium a month, euros. Default 160.
